instructions: Human/domain referee records one decision per case HERE, not in the generated oracle packet (which is a PENDING template regenerated by every run). decision is one of PENDING, ACCEPT, REJECT, REVISE. Every entry must keep rationale, reviewer_identity and contract_citation as strings (empty while PENDING). ACCEPT/REJECT/REVISE require non-empty rationale, reviewer_identity, reviewer_kind (HUMAN or AGENT_REVIEWED_NOT_HUMAN_INDEPENDENT) and contract_citation. An ACCEPT by a HUMAN reviewer requires a real contract citation of the form path:line or path:start-end (several separated by ';'), where the path is a tracked file in this repository (not under .git, not a symlink leaving the repository) and the lines are within the file; 'none', 'n/a', prose, missing files or out-of-range lines are rejected. REJECT and REVISE may cite 'none' to state explicitly that no contract supports the label. REVISE must also give proposed_expected_state; a REVISE never changes the label here: it is applied by appending a new revision to rubric_registry.json. study.py validates this file against the enforced rubric revision and digest and computes confirmed_defects = disagreements whose label is ACCEPTed by a HUMAN reviewer; agent-only acceptances are counted separately and never as confirmed defects. Provenance of reviewer_identity and reviewer_kind is a self-asserted record in this file, not an enforced control (CodeRabbit r4429247096).
